verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Parse as an agentic, layout-aware parser built for LLM pipelines that outputs clean markdown, text, or JSON. Community hands-on reports praise its output on complex layouts, though one user found table output was not in tabular form. Nothing in the evidence shows that repeated headers, footers, or page furniture are actually stripped; 'clean' is only a marketing claim. Missing for 10: documented header/footer and page-furniture removal, independent corroboration of noise-free output.
